$comment: canonical and is-crawlable are skipped locally: Lighthouse compares the canonical against the localhost origin it is testing, which always mismatches. Both are verified against the real origin by scripts/quality/check-routes.ts.
uses-http2 is skipped because the local server is HTTP/1.1; Cloudflare serves HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 in production.
csp-xss is off because it flags the 'unsafe-inline' script-src that Next.js requires; the reasoning is recorded in docs/security-model.md.
Performance is a warning rather than an error: shared CI hardware varies enough that gating on it would fail for reasons unrelated to the change.
